## Contributor checklist

- [ ] File is in `guides-src/`, named after the `slug` in its frontmatter
- [ ] Frontmatter is filled in: `title`, `slug`, `description`, `category`, `updated`, `author`, `author_role`
- [ ] Every factual claim has a named, checkable source (linked or clearly cited in text)
- [ ] The "Before you open a pull request" section from the template has been deleted
- [ ] I've read the house rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Editor checklist (reviewer fills in)

- [ ] Sources check out
- [ ] Category is correct
- [ ] No claims that read as advertorial / paid placement
- [ ] Reads clean — no edits needed, or edits requested below
